simple.note: ALWAYS cheaper than the baseline, every model in the pool, not just the head; ceiling 0.5x, asserted for every simple pool by tests/test_jev_router_pools.py

medium.note: leads BELOW the baseline (operator directive 2026-10-28, cycle 13902: always cheaper, except very complex work); the baseline stays in-pool as the fallback

hard.note: the exception: very complex work escalates, and a dearer head here is the point

policy.rejected_reason: 6.54x the baseline ($3.660/M vs $0.560/M) for a medium coding turn; the suggested pool order put it first. Ratio computed from this file's prices.
policy.rule: Every pool must LEAD with a model cheaper than the baseline. Every model in a SIMPLE pool is cheaper than the baseline. A medium pool may carry the baseline itself as the in-pool fallback. Only `hard` may lead dearer - that is the exception for very complex work.

derivation.basis: blended $/M = catalog cost.input + cost.output, the SAME basis the doctor's cost guard uses; cache_read is carried but not counted
derivation.source: ~/.cache/jev/models_dev.json (models.dev); the filtered extract this list was built from is committed at docs/evidence/jev-router-pools-2026-10-28/catalog-prices.json
